questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: If the day before yesterday was Thursday, what day will it be three days after tomorrow?
questions.solution: Day before yesterday = Thursday → Today = Saturday. Tomorrow = Sunday. 3 days after tomorrow = Wednesday. Wait: today = Saturday. Tomorrow = Sunday. 3 days after Sunday = Wednesday. But Monday is listed first... Let me recalculate: If day before yesterday is Thursday, today is Saturday. Tomorrow is Sunday. Three days after tomorrow: Sunday + 3 = Wednesday.
